title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
problem: Find the minimum cost to connect all points. Cost is Manhattan distance.
hints: Treat points as nodes. Edges are Manhattan distances. Find MST using Prim's or Kruskal's algorithm.
expected_approach: Prim's minimum spanning tree using min-heap.
code:
import heapq
def solution(points):
    n = len(points)
    visited = [False] * n
    h = [(0, 0)]
    cost = 0
    num_visited = 0
    while h and num_visited < n:
        w, u = heapq.heappop(h)
        if visited[u]: continue
        visited[u] = True
        cost += w
        num_visited += 1
        for v in range(n):
            if not visited[v]:
                dist = abs(points[u][0] - points[v][0]) + abs(points[u][1] - points[v][1])
                heapq.heappush(h, (dist, v))
    return cost
